column6: postflight reaps the worktree but never calls leadv2_active_unregister — the active.yaml row preflight wrote survives until the lead's claude PID dies and stale-pid-sweep collects it; every other phase-8 closer (leadv2-phase8-close.sh, fanout, backlog-pump) unregisters, so /leadv2 status shows a ghost task pointing at a deleted lane in the interim
